title: Briefings to Senate Intelligence Committee members and agencies

tellings.quote: to, you know, past members of Senate Select Intelligence Committee. I've provided it to uh numerous three-letter agencies. I've briefed them, given them the locations, the names, etc.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that between about 2023 and 2026 in Washington he shared what he knows with past members of the Senate Select Intelligence Committee, the Senate group that oversees US spy agencies. He says he also briefed several "three-letter agencies", meaning government agencies known by their initials, and gave them locations and names, and he mentions a man named David Grusch. If true, it would mean his claims have been put directly in front of officials.
